title: Reading a profile: the most expensive call versus the most frequent one

videos.script: Lesson twelve ended with a profile and a list of functions. This lesson reads it, and then acts on it. {{flat}} Every row of the list has two numbers. Flat is the time spent in the function itself. Cum adds everything it called. A function can sit at the top of one column and near the bottom of the other, and both are true. {{line}} Then down to the line. pprof shows which line of Parse costs what, who called a function, and what it called in turn. {{flame}} Then the same profile as a flame graph. Width is time. The top edge of each box is the time spent in that box alone. The colours mean nothing. {{fix}} Last, the fix. The profile points at one call, strings dot Fields. A few lines replace it, a fuzz test proves the replacement agrees with the original, and the benchmark runs about twice as fast. {{stop}} And then the hardest part: reading the new profile, and knowing when to stop.
